Ari: Heads-up: BlueNova (acct BN-900) disputed INV-5344 (May) claiming $8.9k in unexpected rerank/embedding overages. They requested 30-day installment and no suspension.
Sam: Can we get model IDs & peak window? need to confirm cause.
Ari: Meter link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-5344  Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/bn-900/usage/2026-05
Lina: CS notes: a beta feature routed traffic to rerank model for 45 minutes overnight. Customer offered $2k now and pay rest over 30 days if we sign plan.
Omar: Ops: quick log scan shows redwood/rerank-small spiked 3.6M tokens 02:15-03:00 UTC. If reroute was our beta flag, consider partial credit.
Ari: Collections proposal: accept $2k upfront, structured 30-day plan (50% at day15, 50% at day30), require DocuSign acknowledgement withdrawing dispute for plan-covered amount, and a temporary soft cap.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 2nd_notice sent to BN-900 for INV-5344 at 2034500005. Escalation: account hold in 7 days if unpaid.
Sam: I'll arrange call to get $2k and signature. If we confirm internal routing fault, we can grant a one-time 15% goodwill credit. Update shortly.
